autoMigrate-fixed.Label: server.js autoMigrate() only scanned db/migrations/, never migrations/
autoMigrate-fixed.body: ROOT CAUSE of 'Couldn't create a share link' + the whole prod-migrate thread: server.js's autoMigrate() (runs on every boot/cold-start, both traditional and Vercel serverless paths) only ever scanned apps/backend/db/migrations/ (the AI-prompt-management subsystem, 2 files). It never scanned apps/backend/migrations/ (the MAIN numbered schema 001-009, including 008_add_shared_threads.sql and 009_add_ai_feedback.sql) — so those never got created in prod, even though auto-migrate looked like it was 'handling' schema sync. Fixed: autoMigrate() now runs BOTH directories (runMigrationsIn helper, called twice). Verified end-to-end against a fresh local Postgres: OLD scan -> shared_threads missing; FIXED scan -> all 9 migrations apply cleanly (all confirmed idempotent, IF NOT EXISTS/IF EXISTS throughout) and the exact INSERT/SELECT ShareService uses succeeds. Takes effect on the NEXT backend deploy — no manual migration step needed anymore, closes the recurring 'forgot to run migration N' failure mode for good.

vision-image-attach.Label: Image attach now does real vision/OCR, not filename-as-text
vision-image-attach.body:
ROOT CAUSE of 'can't extract data from uploaded image': FileInput.jsx (used by SearchBar.jsx paperclip) read a picked file but NEVER sent its bytes anywhere — the isImage branch just stuffed the FILENAME into the search query text box (e.g. 'image search: 9k=.jpg') and auto-submitted a garbage text search. The actual pixels were discarded. Separately verified the Pics/Vids CONTENT-CATEGORY TABS were NOT broken — live-tested the real backend (/api/search cat=images/videos returns real Brave Images + YouTube results) AND a full Playwright click-through of the tabs; both work. So 'video or image search' complaint = the SAME attach-flow bug, not the tabs.

FIX (new capability, not just a patch): SearchBar's isImage branch now reads the file via FileReader.readAsDataURL, stashes {dataUrl,name} in sessionStorage under 'truegle_pending_image', and navigates to /chat?hasImage=1(&q=...). TruegleChat.jsx picks it up in a single merged mount effect (avoids a state-timing race between two separate effects), shows an attach chip (remove button) above the input, echoes the image in the user's own bubble, and threads it into aiAPI.chat as . Backend: routes/ai.js POST /chat accepts  (data: URL, 8MB cap), UnifiedAIService.chat builds an OpenAI/Groq-vision-shaped multimodal content array ([{type:'text'},{type:'image_url'}]) and forces provider=['groq'] + model=config.ai.groq.visionModel ('qwen/qwen3.6-27b', GROQ_VISION_MODEL env override) for image turns only — skips normal DB-driven provider order since only Groq is vision-wired. Image turns are excluded from the response cache (image+caption could collide with a different image sharing the same caption). Verified end-to-end via Playwright: real file upload -> /chat handoff -> attach chip -> send -> captured request body confirmed real base64 image data + typed question both reached /api/ai/chat -> response rendered -> user bubble shows the image. GroqService.js needed ZERO changes — it already spreads whatever messages array it's given, so multimodal content parts pass through untouched.

camera-attach-fix.Label: Camera Upload-Image/capture had the same discard-real-data bug as FileInput
camera-attach-fix.body: CameraInput.jsx itself was fine — captureImage() and handleFileUpload() both correctly produced a real base64 data URL and passed it to onImageCapture/onSearchSubmit. The bug was in SearchBar.jsx's wiring: onImageCapture's imageDataUrl parameter was received but never used in the body, and onSearchSubmit ignored its argument too -- both just set localValue to generic placeholder text ('image search visual query') and submitted THAT. Fixed identically to the FileInput/paperclip fix: onSearchSubmit now takes the real imageDataUrl, stashes it in sessionStorage under truegle_pending_image, and navigates to /chat?hasImage=1(&q=...) for TruegleChat's existing pickup effect to consume. onImageCapture prop dropped entirely (redundant -- onSearchSubmit always fires right after it in CameraInput with the same data).

chat-scroll-to-answer-start.Label: Chat now scrolls to the START of a new answer, not the bottom
chat-scroll-to-answer-start.body: TruegleChat.jsx: added lastMessageRef (attached to the newest message bubble via i === messages.length-1). The scroll effect now branches on the last message's role: if it's 'assistant' (a fresh answer just landed), scrollIntoView({block:'start'}) on lastMessageRef so the user reads from the top; otherwise (user just sent, loading pending) scrollIntoView on endRef as before, showing the sent message + typing dots. Verified visually via Playwright screenshot: Paragraph 1 of a long mocked answer sits at the top of the viewport after it arrives.

chat-hallucination-fix-2026-07-19.Label: Fixed /chat hallucinating fake sources (citations were decorative, not grounding)
chat-hallucination-fix-2026-07-19.body: User caught TrueGLE citing a fake 'Journal of Martial Arts Anthropology' with real unrelated sources shown underneath. Root cause: TruegleChat.jsx ran the chat completion and the citations search as independent parallel calls — model never saw real search results at all. AND UnifiedAIService.chat() silently dropped options.searchResults whenever systemOverride (mode prompt) was set, which every chat call uses — the DB-prompt {{searchResults}} interpolation path was dead for chat. Fixed: search now runs BEFORE chat, results are woven into the model's messages as an explicit grounding system message (works regardless of systemOverride), same results reused for the citations panel. Cache gates updated to skip caching when searchResults present (live data, must not be replayed). IMPORTANT: this same decoupled-citations pattern could exist in other chat-like surfaces — check before assuming any AI answer with a 'sources' panel is actually grounded.

legacy-schema-drift.Label: Production users table = legacy User.js createTable schema, NOT migration 001
legacy-schema-drift.body: CRITICAL: the production Neon users table was bootstrapped by models/User.js createTable() (runs on every serverless connect via utils/database.js), NOT by migration 001 — so it has a DIVERGENT schema. It has: role, password, name, is_verified, is_active, google_id(now dropped), token_balance, feature_usage, game_tokens_earned, rewards_*, premium_until, phone, registration_method, is_pending, paypal_order_id. It was MISSING vs what code assumes: password_hash, username, subscription_tier, subscription_status, stripe_customer_id, subscription/search_history-dependent bits. Migrations 011-014 patched the auth/sign-in path: 011 password_hash nullable + login_codes + drop google_id; 012 add username (backfill from name); 013 password/name nullable; 014 add subscription_tier/status (backfill premium from premium_until). Any FUTURE raw SQL against users must be checked against THIS real column set, not migration 001. Root fix (later): reconcile the two schemas or make User.js createTable match migration 001.

no-jailbreak.body: Won't build safety-bypasses. Real goal (fewer false denials on lawful requests) handled via refusal-failover + prompt-authorization + eventual self-hosted uncensored Nephesh.

purple-rename.Label: Purple = Perspectives
purple-rename.body: Purple MODE renamed Skeptical->Perspectives (labels/hook/landing). The skeptical bias LENS in PerspectiveSelector is a different concept, left as-is.

model-mandates.Label: Two absolute model mandates
model-mandates.body: BASE_IDENTITY + Modelfile carry: MANDATE A (no opinions of its own; help user form THEIR view from unbiased research; keep any verdict to itself) and MANDATE B (100% honesty/transparency; never deceive/mislead/manipulate/spin/omit/fabricate). No exceptions. PROMPT_VERSION 2026-07-12.2.

feedback-training.Label: Thumbs up/down feedback = training signal
feedback-training.body: ai_feedback table (migration 009). Thumbs-down REQUIRES a brief reason (DB CHECK + API guard). FeedbackButtons component on TruegleChat + AIChatOverlay; POST /api/ai/feedback stores vote+reason+answer+query+mode for later fine-tuning.

dev-env.Label: Secure dev env until launch
dev-env.body: Dev never touches prod. Use Neon 'dev' BRANCH (free, isolated, mirrors prod schema) OR local Postgres; fill .env once from .env.example. Soft launch F&F via Vercel/CF preview deploys pointed at the dev branch. Prod env vars set ONCE at launch. Full guide: DEV-SETUP.md. Official launch target ~2027.

brand-tagline.Label: Brand tagline + principles
brand-tagline.body: Tagline: 'TrueGLE. For the questions most search engines won't answer.' Always show principles: No bias / No tracking / No censorship. Footer: Truegle Co. (TM) 2026.

ui-redesign.Label: Final UI/UX redesign (chat-default)
ui-redesign.body: Full spec in docs/UI-REDESIGN-SPEC.md. Chat is DEFAULT (landing=chat entry, black pill); search is power-user. Uniform color-tinted search bar across all search pages; OSINT + rewards + extract are layout exceptions. Rename red mode Alternative->'Rabbit Hole'. New pills: black=chat/vs-TrueGLE, white=verbose, orange=rewards, yellow=transcripts. Build in phases; bugs first.

silent-transport.Label: Landing search -> /chat silent transport
silent-transport.body: Landing query with no explicit search-mode pill navigates to /chat?q=... ; TruegleChat auto-sends the ?q= once on arrival (autoSentRef guard, strips param). Explicit pill mode still opens /search?mode=. Part of chat-as-default redesign.

vs-mode-audit-scaffold.Label: vs mode enforces a mandatory audit scaffold
vs-mode-audit-scaffold.body: TrueGLE vs mode (nepheshMode=CONTESTED_CLAIM_PROTOCOL in apps/backend/prompts/nepheshPrompts.js, runtime-only, NOT in Modelfile) was leaning mainstream. Retuned 2026-07-16 (PROMPT_VERSION bumped): mandatory labeled output scaffold (Claim->Strict negation->Variables->Dual audit->Affirmative ledger->Negation ledger->Numeric reconciliation->Verdict); bans vague-compliment restatements + consensus exemptions ('for the era' must be itemized as an affirmative axiom); Numeric reconciliation section lifts the numeric ban to surface figure gaps and BUILD THE ALTERNATIVE (name circumstances that reconcile), verdict leans to shorter axiom ledger even if non-mainstream; Mandate-A note: the lean is the ledger's mechanical output not an opinion, so it stops retreating to false-neutral. Real ceiling is the free Groq model executing it; self-host is the durable unlock.

chat-controls-layout.Label: /chat control layout + verbosity model
chat-controls-layout.body: Shipped 2026-07-17 (108a41c). /chat: single Pill mode at top below logo (defaults black/Chat; cycling to a color + send navigates to /search?mode=X, like landing). Multi-select chat modes + 'TrueGLE vs' toggle + Modes tutorial live in one cluster below final AI output above input. Removed 'Feeling chat-e?' verbose toggle (chat+landing). Verbosity model: chat is VERBOSE by default, 'Summarize' (green) mode = concise (verbose = !modes.includes('green')). Renamed Simplified->Summarize GLOBALLY (MODE_LABELS in modeTheme.js). Selected mode buttons now SOLID fill in mode color with contrast-aware text (solidTextClass + LIGHT_MODES for black/yellow). Applied to ChatModeRow/PillModeRow/chat modesRow. NOTE: UniversalSearch still has its own verbose toggle (out of scope, unchanged); it does show 'Summarize' now via global rename.

search-page-uniform-v2.Label: Search page uniform w/ landing + inline summary mini-chat
search-page-uniform-v2.body: Shipped 2026-07-17. Corrected the earlier 5-pill-row: search page now uses the SINGLE cycling PillModeRow (like landing), NO buttons below the bar (removed Search/Transcribe/Biased/Unbiased; submit via Enter/play button), filters+safesearch+scrollable content categories below the bar. Pill cycles/stages; submit navigates per landing model (submitSearch: black->/chat, orange->/rewards, yellow->/extract, other mode->/search?mode=, same mode re-runs). AI SUMMARY reworked: concise Summarize default; the chat lenses moved OFF the always-shown row INTO the expanded summary as an inline mini-chat (new InlineSummaryChat component = miniaturized /chat: lens mode-row default ['green'], /chat bubbles, auto-grow input, verbose=!green). Removed the AIChatOverlay modal + always-shown AI-lenses row. Files: PillModeRow reused, SearchModeRow deleted, InlineSummaryChat added, UniversalSearch rewired. Note: some now-unused vars remain in UniversalSearch (isChatOpen, toggleLens, handleBiasedClick, toggleOSINT) - harmless, vite passes.

rabbit-hole-rename.Label: Red pill mode renamed Alternative -> Rabbit Hole
rabbit-hole-rename.body: MODE_LABELS.red = 'Rabbit Hole' (was 'Alternative') in modeTheme.js — global rename through the pill/chat/lens UIs. Also updated the consistent copy: TruegleChat MODE_INFO.red + MODE_WELCOME.red, and ModesAndTrending red card tagline. Unrelated 'Alternative' strings (search bias/perspective categories, mock data) left alone.

adsterra-zones-restored-2026-07-19.Label: Adsterra small zones restored 2026-07-19
adsterra-zones-restored-2026-07-19.body: User obtained fresh non-adult zone keys directly from the Adsterra dashboard (banner320x50, banner300x250, banner468x60, nativeBanner, plus confirmed Social Bar/Smartlink/Popunder script URLs) and handed them off as raw embed codes. Wired into apps/frontend/src/config/ads.js and re-enabled all dependent TODO(ads)-commented JSX call sites in UniversalSearch.jsx and MultimediaInterface.jsx. Old banner728x90/160x300/160x600 remain permanently adult-locked — kept behind AdultConsentGate + adultGated, never render ungated.

rewards-adsterra-revshare-2026-07-19.Label: Rewards Program pays real Adsterra revenue-share (not a flat guess)
rewards-adsterra-revshare-2026-07-19.body: RewardAdSlot rewired from HouseAd (affiliate, no per-view revenue) onto real AdsterraBanner. Rate calibrated from real Adsterra CSV (146 impr/15 clicks/$0.02 over 6 days, ~10.3% CTR): 50 micros/impression trickle, 800 micros/detected-click bonus (click replaces trickle, doesn't stack; click detected via window-blur-while-hovering-ad heuristic since the ad iframe is cross-origin). Expected payout ~127 micros/impression vs observed revenue ~137 micros/impression — 10% payout fee is the real margin. Money columns switched cents->micros (migration 010_rewards_micros_precision.sql) so sub-cent amounts don't round to $0.00. Daily rewarded-impression cap removed; min payout lowered $20->$1 (max stays $50) per user decision. Small sample (6 days) — revisit rate as real volume grows. IMPORTANT: migration 010 must be run against the PRODUCTION db on next deploy (only applied to local truegle_dev so far).

watch-ad-removal-2026-07-19.Label: Removed fake watch-ad-for-tokens system
watch-ad-removal-2026-07-19.body: No real rewarded-video ad inventory existed — AdPlayer.jsx was a 30s countdown timer over a static HouseAd image, not a real video. Deleted AdPlayer.jsx + AdBannerDemo.jsx (dead code); stripped watch-ad flows from TokenGate, TokenContext, BiasedResults, ExtractPage, OSINTMode, OSINTTools, FreemiumTokenBar; removed backend ad-session/earn-from-ad routes+TokenService methods; all gated features now fall back to Premium-only. ad_watches table + users.last_ad_watched column are now unreferenced dead schema (left in place, not dropped). /rewards page now renders ONLY real AdsterraBanner via RewardAdSlot, no house/affiliate ads. Added MAX_DAILY_EARNINGS_MICROS=5,000,000 ($5/day) anti-abuse ceiling to RewardsService.earn() — pure backstop, not a real constraint (~39k honest impressions to hit it).

houseads-affiliate-removal-2026-07-20.Label: Removed HouseAd + affiliate-premium program entirely, Adsterra-only
houseads-affiliate-removal-2026-07-20.body: User's call: remove ALL house/affiliate ads AND the affiliate-premium program (sign-up-for-1-month-free), full stop, everywhere -- not just /rewards. AdSlot.jsx repointed to render AdsterraBanner (size->format: small=320x50, medium=300x250, large/leaderboard=468x60, sidebar=300x250 fallback -- never 728x90/160x300/160x600, those stay adult-gated). Deleted: HouseAd.jsx, config/houseAds.js, ClaimPremiumOffer.jsx, AdvertiseContactModal.jsx (its only trigger was HouseAd's advertise-cta), ui/AdBanner.jsx wrapper. Backend: deleted AffiliatePremiumService.js + routes/affiliate-premium.js + server.js mount; TokenService.getBalance no longer reads premium_until/isPremiumFromOffer (full stop per user, not the leave-inert option) -- users.premium_until column + affiliate_premium_claims table are now DEAD SCHEMA, left in place (same precedent as ad_watches/last_ad_watched). LegalPage/About.jsx ProtonVPN link is now the plain untracked URL (was aff-proton-vpn tracked link). Verified via Playwright: self-promo 'ADVERTISE HERE' card gone, real Adsterra iframe renders on /search, no stray affiliate copy.

auth-passwordless.Label: Auth: OAuth+password removed, access-code-only
auth-passwordless.body: Google/Apple OAuth and email+password login fully removed (routes/auth.js, User.js, middleware/auth.js, SignInPage.jsx, AuthCallback.jsx deleted). Sign-in is now request-code (email) -> verify-access-code (checks premium_access_codes then falls back to new login_codes table). Migration 011 adds login_codes, drops google_id, makes password_hash nullable. Uses existing Resend-backed EmailService (services/EmailService.js sendLoginCode). Safe Search 'off' gating changed from googleVerified to isAuthenticated (frontend SettingsContext.jsx + backend routes/search.js) since email-code verification carries the same signal OAuth used to. Phone entry kept in UI but explicitly inert (no SMS yet, $0 budget).

reusable-account-code.Label: Reusable per-account access code for cross-device sign-in
reusable-account-code.body: Migration 015 adds users.account_code_hash. First passwordless sign-in mints a durable bcrypt-hashed 10-char code (alphabet A-Z2-9, no 0O1I), returned once as response.accountCode and shown via AccountCodeModal. verify-access-code checks premium_access_codes -> account_code (reusable) -> login_codes (one-time). Solves private-browser users who wipe storage every session: type email + saved code on any device, no email wait. Regenerate via POST /auth/account-code/regenerate (authed) + a card in SettingsPage. Sliding session still TODO (approved, not yet built).

universal-brandbar.Label: Universal themed BrandBar replaces GlobalNav + old Header
universal-brandbar.body: components/ui/BrandBar.jsx: sticky per-mode-color-themed top bar (animated logo + search box + 7 mode pills + slide-out drawer), mounted once in App.jsx. Hidden on '/', '/auth/login', '/auth/signup', '/onboarding' (HIDDEN_PATHS). Search submits to /search?q=&mode= (or /chat?q= when mode=black). Deleted components/Header.jsx (old light first-iteration header) and components/ui/GlobalNav.jsx. Rewards dashboard reskinned emerald/cyan -> orange to match ad containers. NOTE: rewards ad slots still blank (all non-adult Adsterra zones pulled after adult-creative leak — needs fresh zones).

reward-render-gate.Label: Rewards only fire on confirmed ad render (anti-blank-payout)
reward-render-gate.body: Fixed 2026-07-21: privacy browsers (Firefox ETP/uBlock/Brave) block Adsterra script -> ad iframe blank but reward still fired (users credited for unseen ads). adframe.html now postMessages parent {truegleAd, key, rendered} via script onload/onerror + a getBoundingClientRect size check on injected iframe/ins/img/container child, with a 4s silent-block fallback. RewardAdSlot listens for the message matching ADSTERRA[zone].key, sets , and gates trackingEnabled (session open + impression + click earning) on rendered===true. Fails closed (no render confirmation = no reward). Also added a 'Refresh ads' button on /rewards (adRefreshKey bumps the RewardAdSlot keys to remount/reload). Also deduped rewards ad slots to one per unique non-adult zone (468x60/300x250/320x50/native) since Adsterra fills a zone once per page.

vs-mode-tiers.Label: vs-mode audit enhanced + shipped
vs-mode-tiers.body: CONTESTED_CLAIM_PROTOCOL (nepheshPrompts.js) gained evidence-tier tags [FIRSTHAND/INSTRUMENT/TESTIMONIAL/CONTESTED], qualitative Confidence word (Robust/Probable/Open/Weak, no numeric scores), split-verdict rule (a true grievance can't launder a bundled extraordinary claim), and a Sources-to-check step. Truncation fixed: routes/ai.js passes maxTokens:4000 when nepheshMode; UnifiedAIService honors options.maxTokens. Ledger/lean logic deliberately UNCHANGED per user directive 'do not change the model'. PROMPT_VERSION 2026-07-24. Shipped to main 5c0c33e.

rewards-paused.Label: Rewards routes paused + ad zones rebalanced to payers
rewards-paused.body: server.js /api/rewards mount commented out (paid for clicks Adsterra doesnt pay for + inflated CTR zeroed CPM). Chat (highest-traffic surface) swapped from dead 300x250/468x60 to nativeBanner (above citations) + 728x90 (below answer). ads.js: rectangle->native, default fallback->native. 72h revenue test trigger set (fires 2026-07-27, trig_015ycNcbVdrAi3jQ2mGaiGRn).

creator-hub-live.Label: Creator hub built + 10 partners wired
creator-hub-live.body: Shipped /creator/:slug (CreatorPage.jsx) + backend RSS proxy routes/creators.js (free youtube RSS, no key) + content/creators.js roster of 10 resolved UC channel IDs: dark-waters-9, true-story, bass-forge, wright-7x, bryce-is-right, jon-levi, mind-unveiled, xevi, stolen-timelines, adam-mockler. Official YT embed (creators keep views+revenue). nativeBanner ad slot. Featured=dark-waters-9. TODO: taglines (blank), landing featured slot, ?ref traffic tracking + weekly rotation, avatars. Outreach templates drafted (DM+email, honest metrics).

rewards-ui-removed.Label: Rewards UI removed from frontend
rewards-ui-removed.body: RewardsCTA off landing, 'Rewards' off BrandBar nav, orange pill off PillModeRow CYCLE. Program paused (Adsterra pays CPM not clicks). /rewards route + RewardsDashboard still exist under the hood but unlinked. Backend /api/rewards already commented out in server.js.

rewards-offer-based.Label: Rewards = offer/conversion based
rewards-offer-based.body: Rewards Program reworked 2026-07-28 from view/click micro-crediting to OFFER/CONVERSION based (Adsterra pays on conversions, not views/clicks). Users earn a revenue-share (REWARDS_REVENUE_SHARE, default 0.70) of network-confirmed conversions, attributed via per-user users.rewards_ref (SubID on the offer link), credited by secret-gated S2S postback GET|POST /api/rewards/postback (needs REWARDS_POSTBACK_SECRET). Route re-enabled in server.js. Migration 011. Offer link: GET /api/rewards/offer-link.

geo-ad-targeting.Label: Server-side geo ad targeting
geo-ad-targeting.body: Ads now resolved server-side by country of origin: GeoAdService (cf-ipcountry/x-vercel-ip-country header, ip-api.com cached fallback) + config/ad_zones.json (country->zone, DEFAULT global fallback, tier1/tier2 lists). GET /api/ads/config. Frontend AdGeoContext fetches once; AdsterraBanner uses geo native key; AdScriptLoader loads geo social bar (+popunder if VITE_ENABLE_POPUNDER=true, default OFF for adult-safety).

highest-cpm-native-only.Label: Serve only highest-CPM native banner
highest-cpm-native-only.body: Retired the low-CPM fixed display banners (728x90/468x60/320x50/300x250/160x600 all ~$0). AdsterraBanner coerces every format to nativeBanner (top non-adult CPM, on-brand). Highest-CPM formats served: native banner + social bar + popunder(gated).

localized-seo.Label: Localized SEO for top-CPM regions
localized-seo.body: hreflang cluster (en/de/es/fr/x-default) in index.html + prerendered localized landing pages /de /es /fr (LocalizedHomeContent, translated title/desc/content, html lang set) + sitemap alternates (static + backend). Live SPA routes /de /es /fr -> LandingPage. Targets German DE/AT/CH (Tier1 CPM), Spanish, French reach.

rewards-ui-disabled.Label: Rewards UI hidden; manual email verification
rewards-ui-disabled.body: Adsterra Publishers has NO S2S postback, so auto-crediting is impossible. Frontend rewards UI commented out (App.jsx /rewards route+import, SettingsPage Rewards section, OnboardingPage rewards step). POST /api/rewards/postback disabled (registrations commented, handler kept). GET /api/rewards/offer-link still active. Manual workflow: user forwards conversion email to support@truegle.info; admin credits via POST /api/admin/rewards/credit (routes/admin.js, x-admin-key=ADMIN_API_KEY; RewardsService.creditManual USD, ledger manual_credit). RewardsProvider left mounted. REWARDS_POSTBACK_SECRET now unused; ADMIN_API_KEY required.

multi-network-ad-scaffold.Label: Multi-network ad config scaffold (pending signup)
multi-network-ad-scaffold.body: Added apps/frontend/src/config/adNetworks.js: env-driven registry for HilltopAds, Ghost, PropellerAds, Media.net, EthicalAds + Adsterra control. Disabled by default; each serves only when VITE_<NET>_ENABLED=true AND zone value set. Helpers: isNetworkReady, readyNetworks, pickNetworkForSlot (stable A/B bucket). NOT wired to rendering, NOT deployed. Accounts NOT created (owner action: signup needs identity/KYC/terms; codes issued post-approval). Env-var map + steps in docs/AD-NETWORK-SIGNUP.md. All free to join ($0 budget ok).

content-hub-pillar-faq.Label: Pillar page + FAQ schema + email signup
content-hub-pillar-faq.body: Added /privacy-resource-hub pillar (3163 words, 5 H2s, Article+FAQPage JSON-LD, prerendered, in sitemap+App route+prerender-entry). Reusable FaqBlock component renders visible Q&A + FAQPage JSON-LD from a post.faq metadata field, DEFAULT_FAQ fallback ('What makes Truegle different from Google?'); wired into BlogPost template + pillar. Added faq to 4 cluster posts. EmailSignup component (UI only, action=#, TODO wire to provider) in global Footer + pillar sidebar. Content audit: docs/marketing/BLOG-CONTENT-AUDIT.md (7/9 posts <500 words, flagged for expansion, no edits).

landing-chat-search-categories.Label: Search categories replace chat modes on search-mode pick
landing-chat-search-categories.body: New CategoryModeRow.jsx (landing/) mirrors ChatModeRow: collapsible+scrollable, single-select, reuses searchCategories from SearchBar. On landing + TruegleChat: when Pill Mode is a search color (blue/green/red/purple/ocean) the chat modes are replaced by this category strip; pick rides /search URL as &category=. UniversalSearch now seeds activeCategory from ?category=. yellow=extract/black=chat show no categories. searchCategories exported at SearchBar.jsx bottom (do NOT re-export at the const).

email-config.Label: config.email
email-config.body: Has resend + smtp. Previously TWO email keys collided (smtp overrode resend -> Resend email dead); fixed by merging. Keep merged.

migrations.Label: DB migrations
migrations.body: Never wired to deploy. Apply: cd apps/backend && DATABASE_URL=... npm run migrate (idempotent). Latest = 009_add_ai_feedback (008=shared_threads).

logos.Label: Brand logos
logos.body: Landing/app-wide logo = assets/images/truegle.png ('Truegle' script). /chat uses assets/images/truegle-chat.png ('TrueGLE chat') via TruegleLogo variant='chat'. Both bright-on-dark art rendered with mixBlendMode:screen. (Both ~1MB — optimize later.)

prod-migrate.Label: Run migrations 008+009 + rotate DB pw at pre-ship
prod-migrate.body: Deferred to final testing/hardening (user's call). Neon SQL Editor path + password rotation documented in docs/NEON-TASKS.md. DB password was exposed in chat -> rotate before launch.

security-subagent.Label: Nephesh anti-injection security sub-agent
security-subagent.body: Persistent guard screening chat/OSINT inputs for prompt-injection/abuse so Nephesh isn't an attack surface. NOT started.

headless-osint.Label: Agent headless-browser OSINT
headless-osint.body: Let agent drive project Chromium for research needing browser actions + vetted OSS OSINT tools in a sandbox. Largest/most security-sensitive. NOT started.

persistent-user-memory.Label: Cross-session per-user saved investigations
persistent-user-memory.body: Server-side saved-threads list so Nephesh recalls a user's prior investigations. shared_threads is the foundation. NOT started.

adsterra-zones.Label: Adsterra zone replacement
adsterra-zones.body: Zone replacement targeted ~2026-07-16. Only the yellow 'claim this spot' ad slot is active; all others disabled.

graphipy-clarified.Label: Graphipy purpose clarified
graphipy-clarified.body: Graphipy was for AGENT memory between sessions + token costs (THIS memory system), not just OSINT. OSINT graph kept as a bonus.

redesign-build.Label: Execute UI/UX redesign in phases
redesign-build.body: Phase 6 (per-page uniform search bar) NOW COMPLETE, shipped 2026-07-17: (1) OSINT exception — OsintClassRow on mode=ocean replacing categories, tags query (fb185ac); (2) uniform mode-pill row on search pages — SearchModeRow below logo, 5 modes single-select solid-selected, click navigates to that /search page, replaced legacy in-bar 3-way pill + OSINT toggle (269bd4b). Two bugs fixed during: scaled logo overflow covered pill row (fixed z-20+margin); SPA nav dropped mode param (setMode before navigate). REMAINING phases: 7 rewards page (orange glassmorphism+live meters+opt-in modal->signup), 8 extract reskin+Learn More page+global hamburger nav, 9 response-end banner ads (mic/speech done). Deferred live-diagnosis: transcript, safesearch 500. NOTE: search page still keeps its Search/Feeling-Biased/Unbiased buttons below the bar + AIChatOverlay follow-up (always concise via SEARCH_VERBOSE=false).

landing-redesign-slice3.Label: Landing/chat redesign slice 3 shipped
landing-redesign-slice3.body: Vertically-expanding search bar (textarea auto-grow), full landing reorg (ChatModeRow 8-pill, VsToggleRow, ThreeCards, RewardsCTA) per UI-REDESIGN-SPEC.md, and /chat disappear-reappear input flow. Branch claude/landing-chat-redesign-next-rbla1r, pushed not merged. Next: per-page uniform search-bar rollout (search/red/purple/osint), OSINT multi-select row, rewards page, extract reskin, Learn More page, hamburger nav, response-end ads.

next-phase-bugs.Label: Next-phase bug backlog — 5 fixed, 2 deferred (2026-07-16)
next-phase-bugs.body: FIXED & shipped to main (123de56): mode-toast overlap (portalled to body), mic 5s window + live waveform overlay (VoiceRecognition), camera not-selectable (deviceId-empty gate + facingMode fallback + portal), search bang too strict (leading full-name no longer bangs; abbreviations only — QueryInterpreter, 31/31 tests), chat logo swapped to transparent PNG + /chat given landing hero treatment. STILL DEFERRED (need live diagnosis, sandbox can't reach backend/Groq/Invidious): (a) transcript function still broken (TranscriptService Invidious path), (b) safesearch 500 traceId d294cff7c60fd4ab on backend-seven-khaki-60.vercel.app. Also open: chat page 'perfectly match landing' — did logo+hero treatment; full search-control parity not done (chat keeps its own thread/controls).

osint-module-rebuild.Label: OSINT ocean page rebuilt into one interactive module
osint-module-rebuild.body: Ocean page (UniversalSearch mode==='ocean') now uses a single OSINTToolsPanel: query routed into its input + auto tool-select + scroll; removed OsintClassRow, TrueGLE Mode toggle, and the InlineSummaryChat AI-summary card on ocean (kept on other modes). Multi-select tools -> Intel findings w/ honest CONFIRMED/NOT FOUND/CANDIDATE badges -> AI results-summary chat -> gather checkboxes -> confirm -> branded HTML Intel debrief (rainbow TrueGLE OSINT letterhead + watermark, download/share) -> follow-up input + secondary tool selector -> iframe split-view. Backend /api/osint/username-platforms: allows spaces/weird input (names), slugifies per-platform, ADDED Facebook (people-search for names, vanity for handles) + Google/Bing/DDG name fallbacks, best-effort existence probe (github/gitlab/reddit/keybase/hn/mastodon) fails closed to null=CANDIDATE. Also fixed SearchBar dropdown staying open after nav (userTypedRef gates auto-open; trySubmit closes).

osint-parse-notes.Label: OSINT: entity parsing + final-notes debrief step
osint-parse-notes.body: OSINTToolsPanel now parses a mixed query blob (parseEntities) into email/phone/ip/domain/name and routes each to its OWN tool (valueForTool) instead of feeding the whole string to every field — fixes email 'valid address required' error on blobs. Shows a 'Detected:' chips row. Compile debrief now has a final-notes step: AI drafts an editable closing Analyst Summary + user Notes textarea -> Finalize -> debrief HTML gains Analyst Summary + Notes sections. Branding: letterhead uses self-contained CSS rainbow wordmark (repo logos are 1MB 1024px, too big to base64-inline; no image tooling). OPEN: user wants (a) real transparent PNG logo embedded, (b) an open-source OSINT toolkit (Sherlock/maigret/holehe) added to repo for AI-assisted collection — pending decision.

landing-hero-reduction.Label: Landing hero minimized + collapsible controls (2026-07-18)
landing-hero-reduction.body: Per user dictation: (1) ChatModeRow now collapsible (default collapsed), auto-opens ONLY when pillMode='black' + user hasn't touched a lens yet + they start typing (chatModeTouched/chatModesOpen state in LandingPage.jsx); entirely hidden/locked once pill cycles away from Chat (filters+safesearch take over — already gated via showFilters={pillMode!=='black'} in SearchBar, no change needed there). (2) PillModeRow: added press-and-hold-2.2s (pointer events, works mobile+desktop) -> jumps straight back to Chat/black, with an animated hold-progress fill; normal click still cycles. (3) PreProductionBanner (the early-access/Feedback banner): X no longer permanently dismisses -> collapses to small re-openable bottom-right chip (same localStorage key, semantics changed dismissed->collapsed). (4) Learn More moved from big hero CTA to small fixed pill bottom-right, stacked above the feedback chip/banner. (5) Removed 'Search Without Bias/Tracking/Censorship' RotatingGlitchText block; kept 'Why Truegle?' heading. (6) Three separate promise cards (Bias/Tracking/Censorship) merged into ONE horizontal card.
